_help: Fill BEFORE any design. playbook/SCRIPT_METHOD.md explains each field; playbook/tools/preflight.mjs checks it. Times in seconds.

product.category: fragrance | lip | face | skin | body | hair | eyes | nails | tool

insight: a true, slightly uncomfortable observation about that person
smp: the ONE thing the reel must land, one sentence, <= 14 words
shape: tension-release | demo | before-after | reframe | desire | pov
hook_type: tension | meme | result | sensory | pun | question | stat
device: the visual idea that delivers the SMP (one world for the whole reel)
device_why: why this device IS the message, in a sentence

recall.what: product name as a stranger would say it

small_ok: texts allowed below 44 px: legal lines, sources
